biggest_catch: The friend's checking account must be 'active' — defined as at least 15 transactions per month — or the $100 bonus will not be paid within the 90-day qualification window.
catches: Friend's checking account must be active (minimum 15 transactions per month).
Friend must not be an existing member, a recent member (previous 6 months), a joint owner on GreenState deposit accounts, or living in the same household as the referrer.
Bonus cannot be combined with other GreenState promotional offers.
GreenState will not share referral status with the referrer due to privacy concerns.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: GreenState Credit Union's official page (greenstate.org/refer-a-friend) runs a Refer a Friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns $100 for each qualifying friend, directly deposited to the referring member's account. No annual cap is stated.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the referred individual (18+, new member only) must open a new checking account with GreenState and mention they were referred at account opening. The new account must meet the qualifications within 90 days: open a new active GrowGreen Checking, Free Checking, or Access Checking account, with 'active' defined as a minimum of 15 transactions per month.

c4.evidence: Timing: the $100 bonus is directly deposited to both parties' accounts within 60 days after the new checking account is opened and is determined active and in good standing.

eligibility: GreenState Credit Union members referring new members age 18+; excluded: existing members, members from the prior 6 months, joint owners on GreenState deposit accounts, same-household referrals.
notes: $100 is directly deposited as cash to both parties' accounts. Limited-time offer; no annual cap stated.
payout_quote: When you refer a friend to open a new and active checking account at GreenState, we will pay you and your friend $100 each.
payout_value_note: Cash directly deposited to the referring member's account.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s5.note: Offer live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); described as a limited-time offer.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: the new member must mention they were referred at account opening.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: be a new member (age 18+); open a new active GrowGreen, Free, or Access Checking account; maintain at least 15 transactions per month; meet qualifications within 90 days.

steps: Refer a friend to GreenState Credit Union.
Friend opens a new checking account as a new member and mentions they were referred at account opening.
Friend keeps the account active (15+ transactions/month) and meets qualifications within 90 days.
$100 is directly deposited to both parties' accounts within 60 days.
timing: $100 directly deposited to both parties' accounts within 60 days after the new checking account is opened and is determined active and in good standing.
when_cash_arrives: $100 directly deposited to both parties' accounts within 60 days after the new checking account is opened and is determined active and in good standing. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
